name: textverktyg
description: Tool for processing text with GenAI

scripts.build: NODE_ENV=${NODE_ENV:-production} pnpm exec prisma generate && NODE_ENV=${NODE_ENV:-production} pnpm exec tsc && NODE_ENV=${NODE_ENV:-production} node build.mjs
scripts.dev:watch: pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm exec tsc --watch
scripts.build:local: NODE_ENV=development pnpm exec prisma generate && NODE_ENV=development pnpm exec tsc && NODE_ENV=development node build.mjs
scripts.build:local:win: set NODE_ENV=development&& pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm exec tsc && node build.mjs
scripts.test: rm -rf dist && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && DATABASE_URL=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-$DATABASE_URL} pnpm exec prisma generate && DATABASE_URL=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-$DATABASE_URL} pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm exec tsc && DATABASE_URL=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-$DATABASE_URL} node --test --test-concurrency=1 "dist/tests/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:nodb: rm -rf dist && pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm exec tsc && DATABASE_URL= node --test --test-concurrency=1 "dist/tests/**/*.test.js"
